blocks.text: An unfinished room leaves a small gap in the pet’s rendered outline.
Location: The Museum of Unfinished Rooms
Appearance: Actual edge pixels disappear into incomplete construction strokes that repeatedly fail to finish the outline.
Care: Use targeted chronic treatment listed in Care; rest alone does not cure it.
Story connection: A curator could ask whether completing a room would erase its residents’ intentions.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
